With respect to the income tax proceedings for Assessment Year 2012–13, the Company had preferred an appeal before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) against certain additions/disallowances made by the Assessing Officer and sustained by the appellate authority. Pursuant to the order of the ITAT, the Company has filed an application before the Assessing Officer for giving effect to the ITAT's directions (Order Giving Effect), and the matter is currently pending before the Assessing Officer.

With respect to the income tax proceedings for Assessment Year 2009–10, the Company had filed an appeal before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) challenging the validity of the order passed under Section 154 of the Income-tax Act, 1961, as well as certain additions/disallowances made by the tax authorities. Pursuant to the ITAT's order, the Company has filed an application before the Assessing Officer for passing the Order Giving Effect (OGE) to the ITAT's directions, which is currently pending.
